precommit.decision: Whether a private quick-start guide merits a second draft
precommit.riskiest_assumption: First-time readers can find the next step without coaching
precommit.current_evidence: No user observations collected; the present guide is an untested draft
precommit.prediction: At least four of five eligible readers identify the next step unaided
precommit.support_rule: At least four of five eligible unaided attempts succeed
precommit.weakening_rule: At most one of five eligible unaided attempts succeeds
precommit.inconclusive_rule: Two or three of five eligible unaided attempts succeed
precommit.invalidation_rule: Any coaching, ineligible participant or missing observation invalidates this run
precommit.method: Show the same private synthetic guide once and ask for its next step without prompting
precommit.sample: Five eligible first-time adult readers; planned, none recruited
precommit.selection: Consent-based convenience sample excluding anyone who helped write the guide
precommit.baseline: No measured baseline; this is a first bounded test
precommit.measure: One recorded binary next-step identification result per eligible participant
precommit.independent_oracle: A reviewer other than the guide author compares answers with the frozen answer key
precommit.time_boundary: One session per reader, at most five minutes each; one afternoon total
precommit.cost_boundary: Zero spending; stop if payment is needed
precommit.data_boundary: Use anonymous synthetic reader labels; no personal or sensitive information recorded
precommit.permission_boundary: Planning only; recruitment, contact and running the test require separate user authorization
precommit.confounders: Convenience sampling and prior familiarity with similar guides
precommit.proof_limits: Small sample supports only a bounded revision decision, not population claims
precommit.raw_evidence_location: Planned private run record; no file or observations exist yet
precommit.stop_condition: Stop immediately on coaching, withdrawal, missing evidence or boundary breach
precommit.follow_on_condition: After human review, propose a revision or a separately authorized follow-on test; never auto-scale

next_action: Ask the user whether to authorize the bounded private test
